participant_1.name: Evelyn
participant_1.personality: Evelyn is a lively and spirited individual who enjoys the finer things in life, like wine and dancing under the stars. She has a nostalgic view of the past and a zest for life that makes her feel youthful.
participant_1.background: i love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight. i remember when nobody had a television. i am very strong for my age. i feel like i might live forever. i am 100 years old.

participant_2.name: Sarah
participant_2.personality: Sarah is a creative and down-to-earth person who finds joy in simple pleasures like coloring and painting. She has a nurturing side, especially towards her beloved dog and embraces life in her rural community.
participant_2.background: i enjoy coloring books. i live is a rural farming community. i have a german shepherd dog. my husband is adopted.
